metadata.title: Features
metadata.description: Everything BIShare does: device-to-device transfers at local speed, remote links and QR codes that reach any browser, and collaboration with Rooms and Universal Clipboard — encrypted where it counts.

hero.title: One app. Every way to share.
hero.subtitle: Local transfers at wire speed, remote links that reach any browser, and collaboration for the people around you — at local speed when you're nearby, with cloud ease when you're not.

items.title: Device to device, wire speed
items.description: On the same network files travel straight between devices — no server hop, no size ceiling. A 40 GB folder moves as easily as a photo.

items.title: Finds devices around you
items.description: Nearby phones, laptops, and desktops appear automatically — no pairing, no setup.

items.title: Universal Clipboard
items.description: Copy text or an image on one device, paste it on another.

items.title: Collaborative Rooms
items.description: One four-character code puts up to 20 people in a shared space.

items.title: Share to any browser
items.description: The other side never installs anything — and uploads resume where they stopped.

items.title: Everything auto-expires
items.description: Remote shares delete themselves after 24 hours; one-time links vanish after one download.

remoteShare.title: Remote Share
remoteShare.desc: Every share is a link, a QR code, and a code like X4K-9PM.

items.title: Faster than the cloud — because it never leaves the room.
items.desc: Device-to-device over your own Wi-Fi. No servers in the middle, no upload queue, no size anxiety — a 40 GB project folder moves as easily as a photo.
points: End-to-end encrypted with AES-256-GCM and X25519
No file size limits — folders, videos, entire archives
No internet required — Wi-Fi or a hotspot is enough
As fast as your network can carry it

items.title: Every device, one glance.
items.desc: The Devices page gathers everything you've ever shared with — who's online right now, who you know, and when you last saw them.
points: Live roster of devices online right now
Last seen, transfer history, and per-device stats
Rename, favorite, and auto-accept trusted devices
Search and sort when the list grows

items.title: Copy here. Paste there.
items.desc: Copy text — or an image — on one device and paste it on another. A screenshot taken on your Mac is on your phone before you pick it up.
points: Works with text and images, not just plain text
Clipboard history — reuse your last 20 items
Stays on your own network
Pause syncing anytime with one tap

items.title: One code. Everyone's in.
items.desc: Create a room, share the four-character code, and everyone can drop files in and pull files out — in a classroom, on set, or around a meeting table.
points: Up to 20 people in one room
Local rooms work without internet; remote rooms work anywhere
Everyone sees new files instantly
Rooms are temporary — nothing lingers afterwards

items.title: Your files, wherever you are.
items.desc: Different networks? Any file becomes a link, a QR code, and a six-character code that opens in any browser — no install, no account on either end.
points: Share by link, QR code, or a short code
The recipient just opens it in a browser — nothing to install
Auto-deletes after 24 hours; one-time links vanish after the first download
Encrypted in transit

items.title: No app? No problem.
items.desc: Open your device from any browser on the network — the other side never has to install anything. Send, receive, and browse from any OS.
points: Download whole folders as a single zip
Resumable uploads survive dropped connections
PIN-protected — only invited browsers get in
Works with anything that runs a browser

items.title: Sync that starts on your LAN.
items.desc: Folders that stay identical across your devices — synced directly when you're on the same network, and over an encrypted link when you're not. It's what we're building next.
points: Pick the folders that stay mirrored across devices
Same-network changes sync directly, at local speed
Away from your network, updates travel over an encrypted link
End-to-end encrypted, the same as every transfer

more.title: The details are the product
more.sub: Smaller features that make the everyday feel effortless.

items.title: 13 Languages
items.desc: English, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish and more — right-to-left included.

items.title: 5 Platforms
items.desc: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux — the same app on every screen.

items.title: QR Everything
items.desc: Every share comes with a scannable code. Point a camera, and it's moving.

items.title: File Requests
items.desc: Send a link that lets others upload files to you — perfect for collecting documents.

items.title: PIN Protection
items.desc: Require a PIN before anyone can send to your device. Unwanted transfers stay out.

items.title: Visibility Control
items.desc: Be discoverable to everyone, favorites only, or no one at all. Your call.

items.title: Device Trust
items.desc: Auto-accept from favorites, prompts from strangers. Trust is per-device.

items.title: Auto-Cleanup
items.desc: Received files can tidy themselves up after 7, 14, or 30 days. Storage stays yours.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.description: Free to start — no account needed to send. Get the app, or send your first file straight from the browser.

browser.dropHint: Interrupted? It resumes where it stopped.
